name: chat-thread-01
title: Chat Thread
description: Composable streaming conversations with message versions and checkpoint restoration.

files.content:
import type { ChatThreadLabels } from "./chat-thread-types";
export const chatThreadEnLabels: ChatThreadLabels = {
    conversation: "Conversation",
    navigation: "Messages",
    empty: "What are we working on?",
    loadOlder: "Load earlier messages",
    loadingOlder: "Loading earlier messages…",
    loadFailed: "Could not load earlier messages. Try again.",
    latest: "Scroll to latest",
    copy: "Copy message",
    copied: "Message copied",
    copyFailed: "Could not copy. Select and copy the message instead.",
    edit: "Edit message",
    cancel: "Cancel",
    save: "Save and send",
    saveFailed: "Could not send the edit. Try again.",
    retry: "Try again",
    stopped: "Response stopped",
    good: "Good response",
    bad: "Bad response",
    rated: "Feedback updated",
    previous: "Previous version",
    next: "Next version",
    checkpoint: "Checkpoint",
    restore: "Restore",
    restoreTitle: "Restore checkpoint?",
    restoreCode: "Restore conversation and code",
    restoreConversation: "Conversation only",
    restoring: "Restoring…",
    restored: "Checkpoint restored",
    restoreFailed: "Could not restore the checkpoint. Try again.",
    undo: "Undo",
    undone: "Restore undone",
    undoFailed: "Could not undo the restore. Try again.",
    streaming: "Streaming response",
    message: (index, text) => `Message ${index}: ${text}`,
    version: (index, count) => `Version ${index} of ${count}`,
    changedFiles: (count) => `${count} ${count === 1 ? "file" : "files"} changed`,
    restoreImpact: (messages, files) => `Removes this message and ${Math.max(0, messages - 1)} later messages${files ? `, and reverts ${files} ${files === 1 ? "file" : "files"}` : ""}.`,
};
export const chatThreadZhLabels: ChatThreadLabels = {
    conversation: "对话",
    navigation: "消息导航",
    empty: "今天一起完成什么？",
    loadOlder: "加载更早的消息",
    loadingOlder: "正在加载历史消息…",
    loadFailed: "历史消息加载失败，请重试。",
    latest: "回到最新内容",
    copy: "复制消息",
    copied: "消息已复制",
    copyFailed: "复制失败，请选择消息后手动复制。",
    edit: "编辑消息",
    cancel: "取消",
    save: "保存并发送",
    saveFailed: "编辑发送失败，请重试。",
    retry: "重试",
    stopped: "回复已停止",
    good: "有帮助",
    bad: "没有帮助",
    rated: "评价已更新",
    previous: "上一个版本",
    next: "下一个版本",
    checkpoint: "检查点",
    restore: "恢复",
    restoreTitle: "恢复到此检查点？",
    restoreCode: "恢复对话和代码",
    restoreConversation: "仅恢复对话",
    restoring: "正在恢复…",
    restored: "已恢复检查点",
    restoreFailed: "检查点恢复失败，请重试。",
    undo: "撤销",
    undone: "已撤销恢复",
    undoFailed: "撤销失败，请重试。",
    streaming: "正在生成回复",
    message: (index, text) => `消息 ${index}：${text}`,
    version: (index, count) => `第 ${index} 个版本，共 ${count} 个版本`,
    changedFiles: (count) => `${count} 个文件已更改`,
    restoreImpact: (messages, files) => `将移除此消息及之后的 ${Math.max(0, messages - 1)} 条消息${files ? `，并还原 ${files} 个文件` : ""}。`,
};
